pages.quiz:
BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

15. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of Life.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of Life.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of Life.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of Life.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
